headline: Adds the Guild Wars 2 theme to the Next interface and fixes a bank crash with certain themes.

entries.title: Guild Wars 2 theme for Next
entries.details: Adds the Guild Wars 2 theme to the Next interface, featuring the authentic world map frame, custom header and footer bands, an external side panel for actions, and themed buttons, tabs, and controls.

entries.title: Crash when opening the bank
entries.details: Fixed an error when opening the bank or guild bank while using themes without a background color wash, such as Parchment or Quiet.
